symbols.name: portfolio_graph_cancel_new
symbols.result: Nonzero inert one-shot token; zero is refusal

symbols.name: portfolio_graph_cancel_signal
symbols.result: 1 succeeds for Fresh or Running; 0 refuses

symbols.name: portfolio_graph_cancel_release
symbols.result: 1 removes Fresh or Finished; Running and unknown refuse

symbols.name: portfolio_term_graph_controlled
symbols.signature: char* portfolio_term_graph_controlled(const uint8_t* input, size_t length, uint64_t token, uint64_t timeout_ms)
symbols.result: Owned JSON status/result allocation freed exactly once with portfolio_term_free

caller_contract: The input range stays live during the synchronous call. All token, graph, invocation and free operations use the originating captured library. Bare u64 IDs may coincide across libraries; native cross-library collision rejection is not claimed.
execution_scope: Only explicit indexed graph/book creation, matching indexed pricing, info and clear are controlled. Each call receives a fresh deadline and one-shot flag; a graph retains neither. Runtime fields are not financial input or cache/source identity.
outer_scope: Bounded thread-safe IO callback, whole-job deadline, durable lease/cancellation and atomic publication fences remain caller-owned. A cold book operation may make two calls. This capability provides cooperative checkpoints, not a hard interrupt or aggregate RSS/scale acceptance.
